notes: Sources are tried by ascending priority.
If a WinGet install fails and a Chocolatey source is configured, Chocolatey is tried automatically.
Manual sources open the publisher page and require user interaction.
Package availability can change over time; use Refresh/Validate sources in the manager.
Registry detection uses exact case-insensitive DisplayName matches from registryNames only; no fuzzy matching.
